Ziva.sh | Expert Godot developer | Remote | Contract position

Ziva.sh integrates AI to make developing games in Godot over 2x faster. We are an early stage company with developers in Canada, US and India, and are looking for Godot experts to use and enhance our product.

Compensation depends on developer ability, and we offer flexible hours and equity.

Email dan@ziva.sh with a brief overview of your Godot work to apply.
